[[Shezel Slowreaper]] is a [[plant]] [[boss]] found in the [[The Mirror of Lyss|Mirror of Lyss]]. Unlike the [[Enchanted Brambles]] (who are also [[dervish]]es), Shezel resembles a [[Storm Jacaranda]] (an [[elementalist]]).

==Locations==
* [[Vabbi]] 
** {{NPC location|The Mirror of Lyss}} (on a small island in the south-central area)

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Aura of Thorns}}
* {{skill icon|Crippling Sweep}} 
* {{skill icon|Ebon Dust Aura}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Irresistible Sweep}} 
* {{skill icon|Staggering Force}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Malodorous Mass]]
* [[Monstrous Eye]]
* [[Sentient Spore]]
* [[Shezel's Reaper]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* Shezel will not spawn if [[the Search for Survivors]] is active.
* There is [[Buried Treasure]] on the island where Shezel is located.
